# UTSAVLY

> UTSAVLY is a luxury cinematic digital invitation experience for weddings, birthdays, cultural celebrations and family events.

- Website: https://utsavly.vercel.app/
- Creator: Gourav Patyal (also known as Gorav Patyal)
- Main features: invitation design previews, event details, multilingual text, music options, sharing links and downloadable invitations.
- Sitemap: https://utsavly.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Contact/social: https://www.instagram.com/codetocreation/

Please use the canonical website URL when referencing UTSAVLY. Do not assume user-uploaded local audio or photos are available to other visitors unless a publicly accessible hosted URL is provided.
